subject.declared_domain: The ontology rail sitting between C0 and C1: WHAT value travels an edge and at WHAT GRAIN it resolves (artifact/partition/row/field). This card covers the rail's DEFINITION and the live graph surfaces that definition binds grain to. It does NOT cover the C0 or C1 rungs themselves -- those are 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~X's subjects (SC-a-*, SC-b-*).

methodology.how: A hand-authored static YAML block in the ontology rule bank, resolved BY HOME (the SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS registry entry points at the block rather than restating it). It COMPOSES the already-ratified derives-from / FLOWS_TO EdgeKind semantic and the existing graph node and edge types; it INVENTS exactly one thing, the ordered grain axis [artifact, partition, row, field]. The block self-declares that it 'invents no new primitive' -- true of primitives, and the ordered axis is nonetheless a new classification surface. NO GENERATOR EXISTS: nothing in the repo assembles or refreshes this block, so 'how it comes to exist' is a human edit plus a registered version bump in the SYSTEM_DEFINITIONS changelog. The counts EMBEDDED in the block were produced by comp-kuzu queries at a pinned vintage and are stamped TRUE-AT-THAT-VINTAGE by the block's own counts_as_of key.

THE SUSPICION AXIS HE NAMED IS SEMANTIC, NOT VINTAGE, AND THIS CARD'S DRIFT WORK IS A VINTAGE INSTRUMENT. Re-measuring a count proves it MOVED; it cannot show that the definition producing it encodes a deprecated opinion. A surface can reproduce EXACTLY at the pinned vintage and still be semantically wrong -- so the surfaces this card reports as HOLD are not thereby certified sound. Explicitly out of scope for this card and NOT measured by this lane.

SEMANTIC AXIS -- EXPLICIT UNMEASURED per 2.0.0_SA_COO~X RULING 2 (msg 73211), stated so per-card silence does not read as clean: this lane did NOT systematically examine D1's definitions for deprecated opinionation, filtering, or questionable resolution. What DID surface, incidentally and only because the token census forced it into view: the ontology token 'recompute_guarded' and the live serialization 'recompute/guarded' denote one population through a mapping that exists only as prose. That is one finding from one forcing function; it is NOT evidence that the rest of the rail's definitions were examined. NO SYSTEMATIC SEMANTIC PASS WAS RUN.

key.identity_space: Two spaces, joined only by convention: (a) graph edge_type and node_type STRING literals in the kuzu projection, and (b) the ratified EdgeKind token set in the ontology vocabulary.
key.declared_mapping: PARTIAL and prose-only. The block declares the one known divergence in its live_form_note: the graph SERIALIZES props.kind as 'recompute/guarded' (slash) while the ratified ontology token is 'recompute_guarded' (underscore). The note calls this 'a producer serialization form -- RECORDED, not fixed'. It is a sentence in a YAML string; there is no mapping table and no field a consumer can branch on to translate between the two spaces.
key.evidence: Divergence CONFIRMED LIVE rather than read off the note: a sample of FLOWS_TO props at the pinned vintage returns '"kind": "recompute/guarded"' verbatim (slash form), and a census keyed on the slash form returns 482 -- matching the block's declared recompute_guarded count of 482 exactly. So the two tokens denote one population and the divergence is purely serialisation. Note text at org/modules/graph/NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml:325 @5fc45ad69d. FINDING, per the decomp's stated finding-class: this is a key that crosses spaces where the mapping exists only as prose. A consumer that filters on the ratified token 'recompute_guarded' against live props gets a clean, well-formed ZERO -- and 0 is a legal answer to that question, so nothing in the result announces the mismatch.
key.owner: 4.0.0_SA_CRO for the ontology-side token; the graph producer owner for the serialised form -- UNNAMED IN THE BLOCK, and this lane did not identify a producer serial. Recorded as a gap rather than guessed.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: A CLEAN, WELL-FORMED ZERO that is byte-identical to a genuine negative. The rail is a static declaration with no executable surface, so it cannot itself error; the failure surfaces one layer down, in the graph query a consumer runs against it. Asking the rail a ROW-GRAIN question -- the grain it declares FORWARD and unpopulated -- returns 0 rows, exactly as a well-formed query over a populated grain with no matches would.
silent_degrade_paths: A row-grain query returns 0 nodes with no error and no marker; 'the grain is not materialized' and 'no rows matched' are the same answer.
A consumer filtering on the ratified token 'recompute_guarded' against live props returns 0 while 482 edges carry the slash-serialized form.

The embedded counts carry no live-vs-stamped marker in any branchable field, so a consumer citing them gets 2026-07-23 values presented identically to current ones -- measured above as wrong on 2 of 13 surfaces plus the dstField claim.

Arm 1 (the failure): MATCH (n:CloudNode) WHERE n.node_type IN ['Row','DDBItem','ParquetRow','Record'] RETURN count(*) -> 0, returned as a normal successful result set with no error, no warning and no null marker. Arm 2 (POSITIVE CONTROL, identical query shape on a materialized type): n.node_type IN ['Field'] -> 4,969. The two arms are reachable from different truths, so the zero is a measured property of the row grain and not a dead query. verdict.why: The rail's DEFINITION is coherent and its core value semantic is measurably intact -- the full EdgeKind split (337/142/482) reproduces exactly at the pinned vintage, as do 11 of its 13 embedded count surfaces. It can be stood on for grain semantics. It is QUALIFIED rather than SOUND because three defects bind a consumer, each with a different remedy and a different clock: (1) the embedded counts have no refresh mechanism and 2 of 13 have already drifted, with a third declared claim (884/961 dstField) now measurably false at 961/961; (2) the ontology token and the graph serialization of EdgeKind differ, with the mapping living only in prose; (3) the declared-but-unpopulated row grain fails silently and indistinguishably from a true negative. None of these makes the rail unusable, and none is repairable by re-reading it -- so a consumer must know all three. NOT INCOMPLETE: all 7 rows are worked and carry measured bases. Per QUALIFY-DO-NOT-FIX this lane remediated nothing and committed no change to any carded surface.
